annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Development and Information (Singapore)
key_provisions_or_claims: Ten refreshed priorities across NAIS 2.0 enablers, announced 20 May 2026
National AI Missions in advanced manufacturing, financial services, connectivity and healthcare
Strengthen layered AI governance, sector-specific risk management, and AI testing and assurance
Over S$1 billion for public AI research and talent 2025-2030
Expand compute with green data centres; Singapore to chair ASEAN in 2027
annotation.summary_en: Factsheet from Singapore's MDDI announcing an update to the National AI Strategy (NAIS 2.0), with ten refreshed priorities covering industry AI Missions, government, research, talent, compute, data, trusted governance and international leadership. It is innovation-oriented and has no embodied AI or robotics content.
